context:
Goal: the cloud plan is easy to find when it's needed.
Problem (goal): the plan record and its setup script sit only on branch claude/cloud-feasibility-e01860. Merging it puts a plan on main that nobody has measured yet.
Based on (read): the branch at 0a305e5.
Departs from: main has no docs/plans/cloud-sessions.md — option a adds it and its setup script, through the batch runner.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check timed out.

options.gain: The plan is findable on main.
options.how: The batch runner merges the plan and script; docs/plans holds work not yet shipped.
options.label: Merge it as a plan

options.how: The branch stays as it is.
options.label: Leave it on its branch
options.lose: The plan is easy to lose on a branch.

title: Merge the cloud sessions plan and its setup script to main, as a plan?
why: docs/plans is the home for work not yet shipped, so an unmeasured plan belongs there.
